title: PUT /books/{id} on a non-existent id returns 500 instead of 404
evidence: database.go:93 UpdateBook returns errors.New("book not found"), but main.go:232 updateBookHandler checks `err == sql.ErrNoRows`, which never matches, so it falls through to http.StatusInternalServerError. Untested — TestUpdateBook only updates an existing book.
suggestion: Return sql.ErrNoRows from UpdateBook (as DeleteBook does), or use errors.Is against a shared sentinel, so the handler maps the missing case to 404.

title: mattn/go-sqlite3 pinned to mis-tagged v2.0.3+incompatible
evidence: go.mod:6 requires github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 v2.0.3+incompatible; the maintained line is v1.14.x. Build and tests pass (defect_rate=1.0), so it resolves, but the +incompatible pin is a known bad tag.

title: Test URL construction only works for single-digit book IDs
evidence: main_test.go:158,222,262,269 build paths with string(rune('0'+createdBook.ID)); this maps ID 10 -> ':' etc. It passes only because each test uses a fresh :memory: DB where the first insert is ID 1.
